applies_to: Badger Meter VN2000 vortex flow meters for steam, gas and liquids (including BTU/energy models) with the optional BACnet MS/TP card.
summary: The VN2000 vortex meter has an optional BACnet MS/TP interface with a short fixed object list: flow or energy rate, net totalizer, two temperatures and pressure, plus a totalizer reset. Flow and energy units follow the meter setup.
notes: Points from Table 1 of the protocol manual; the table gives a description per object rather than a separate object name.
The object table lists the reset as BV-1, but the PICS in the same manual lists a Binary Output instead of a Binary Value; check on the meter.
Temperature and pressure values may be manual override values or not live on meters without the matching sensor.
No access column; access is inferred from object type.

source.title: VN2000 Flow Meters - BACnet MS/TP Communication Protocol

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP baud, MAC (0-127) and device ID from the keypad in program mode level 2, then read flow or energy rate (AI 1), the totalizer and temperatures.

minimum_points.name: Flow Rate(Flow Model) / Energy Rate (BTU Model)
minimum_points.why: Flow rate, or energy rate on BTU models

setup: Baud 9600, 19,200, 38,400 or 76,800 (per the intro; the PICS lists 19,200-115,200), MAC 0-127 and device ID 0-4194302 are set on the keypad.
Bus length up to 4000 ft; the meter does not terminate the line.
gotchas: On meters with a manual temperature or pressure override, the AI returns the override value, not a live reading.

points.name: Flow Rate(Flow Model) / Energy Rate (BTU Model)
points.description: Flow rate, or energy rate on BTU models
points.units: gal, L, ft3, m3, lb, kg, BTU, kBTU, ton per s/min/h/day

points.name: Pressure
points.description: Pressure used in the flow calculation
